newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Plutonic March qtr gold production jumps.
newsitem.headline: Plutonic March qtr gold production jumps.

text.p: Western Australian gold producer Plutonic Resources Ltd said on Wednesday March quarter gold production totalled 121,922 ounces, at a cash operating cost of A$403 per ounce.
The figure was up on the 84,285 ounces produced in the previous corresponding period, but down on 132,55 ounces in the December 1996 quarter.
The main Plutonic mine produced 61,093 ounces, its fourth highest quarterly production, at a cash operating cost of A$371 per ounce.
Plutonic also said it has four rigs in operation at its Centenary deposit, where it recently doubled the resource estimate to 2.1 million ounces.
The deposit remained open and further increases in resource estimate could be expected as drilling continued.
A decline was being driven from Plutonic's existing Darlot underground mine to intersect the Centenary deposit and was expected to reach the lode in the fourth quarter of 1997.
